verdict.rationale: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs is a government company registry and filing portal, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external servers to use their tools is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt 403 probes and shows no AI-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
